atlas_basic.title: T1110.004 Credential Stuffing
atlas_basic.logic: COUNT(authentication_failed BY source_ip, 10m) >= threshold AND DISTINCT_COUNT(account) >= threshold -> ALERT

strategies.name: Credential Stuffing Detection via Reused Breached Credentials Across Services

analytics.name: Analytic 1262
analytics.guidance: Multiple failed authentication attempts using distinct username/password pairs from a single IP address or session within a short time window, targeting common services like RDP or SMB

tuning.description: Minimum number of unique usernames in failed login attempts before triggering alert
Duration (e.g., 5 minutes) to observe the behavior chain of rapid login attempts
Whether to group by full IP or CIDR block for bursty behavior from botnets

analytics.name: Analytic 1263
analytics.guidance: Rapid login failures across different users from a single IP address, targeting SSH or PAM login with distinct username-password pairs

tuning.description: Ratio of failed logins per unique user attempted
Restrict detection to certain protocols (e.g., sshd, login, su)

analytics.name: Analytic 1264
analytics.guidance: Burst of failed authentications with rotating usernames against loginwindow or remote management service using reused breached credentials

tuning.description: Tunable threshold for number of attempted usernames in a time window
Restrict behavior detection to remote login interfaces

analytics.name: Analytic 1265
analytics.guidance: Same source IP performing multiple authentication attempts using known breached username/password combinations across different identities in Azure AD, Okta, or Duo

tuning.description: Optional enrichment using known leaked credentials database
Targeting only federated or hybrid identity auth flows

analytics.name: Analytic 1266
analytics.guidance: Multiple sign-in failures against cloud-based applications using username/password combinations leaked from unrelated domains

tuning.description: Correlate credentials reused across multiple SaaS platforms
Number of failed logins from same IP before alerting

analytics.name: Analytic 1267
analytics.guidance: Router/firewall/syslog logs showing authentication failures with unique usernames and reused credentials from same source IP

tuning.description: Limit detection to interactive logins rather than SNMP/RPC
Detection trigger when failure rate exceeds normal profile

analytics.name: Analytic 1268
analytics.guidance: Credential stuffing attempts against Kubernetes API or containerized login shells using stolen or leaked user credentials

tuning.description: Detect attempts across multiple pods/namespaces using same IP
Number of username/password pairs used in attack attempt

analytics.name: Analytic 1269
analytics.guidance: Use of leaked credential pairs against Outlook Web Access (OWA), Microsoft 365, or Exchange from a single client IP with multiple failures

tuning.description: Optional: cross-reference to haveibeenpwned or internal credential dumps
Tunable value for how many unique mailbox attempts trigger alert

analytics.name: Analytic 1270
analytics.guidance: Burst of failed login attempts across VM instances using leaked credential pairs from single IP in public cloud environments

tuning.description: Define if detection should group logins per host or across cluster
Correlate against past IP reputation or behavioral profiles
